mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record mr INNER JOIN patient p ON mr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE mr.diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND mr.diagnosis != '' AND mr.visit_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{timeRange} MONTH) AND ( #{hospitalId} IS NULL -- 系统管理员能看到所有数据 OR u.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} -- 医院管理员只能看自己医院的数据 )

SELECT mr.diagnosis as diseaseName, DATE_FORMAT(mr.visit_date, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count FROM medical_record mr INNER JOIN patient p ON mr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE mr.diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND mr.diagnosis != '' AND mr.visit_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{timeRange} MONTH) AND ( #{hospitalId} IS NULL -- 系统管理员能看到所有数据 OR u.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} -- 医院管理员只能看自己医院的数据 ) GROUP BY mr.diagnosis, DATE_FORMAT(mr.visit_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(mr.visit_date, '%Y-%m'), mr.diagnosis
